obligations.body: The module contains exactly three selected variants for basis sizes 2, 4, and 8.
Each variant requires an exact admitted basis presentation for coefficient carrier A of the matching size.
Each variant requires exact admitted basis presentations of the same size for three distinct role carriers V, M, and P.
Each variant requires KAPPA to be a total single-valued unary relation A->A, and no stronger KAPPA law.
Each variant requires FV:V->A to satisfy the exact linear-bijection schema.
Each variant requires FM:M->A to satisfy the exact linear-bijection schema.
Each variant requires FP:P->A to satisfy the exact linear-bijection schema.
For every basis index i in the selected variant, FV(v_i)=e_i.
For every basis index i in the selected variant, FM(m_i)=e_i.
For every basis index i, some ke_i is the KAPPA image of e_i and FP(p_i)=ke_i.
The wrapper does not identify V, M, P, or A; their relation is only through the represented maps.
No involution/anti-involution, algebra product, triality, reflection, or cross-track semantics is part of the selected wrapper module.

closure_rule: Every selected wrapper must reconstruct exactly from already-provisional basis/function/linear-bijection authority and explicit basis-anchor incidence. No stronger KAPPA or role-identity semantics may be inferred.
